links.outcome: LLM adherence to 2024 ESC hypertension guideline knowledge on 40 questions
links.effect: Correct on 33/40 (82.5%) Claude, 32/40 (80.0%) ChatGPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Flash; no significant difference (p>0.99); tendency toward overly aggressive management in complex scenarios.
links.quote: Claude 4.5 Sonnet achieved the highest numerical accuracy, providing correct responses to 33 out of 40 questions (82.5%).

screen.reason: Evaluates the adherence and accuracy of three free-tier LLMs on clinical questions and vignettes derived from the 2024 ESC hypertension guidelines without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
